import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class FieldMod {
        private static final long MOD = 1000000007;
        private long v;

        public FieldMod(long x) {
            v = x % MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
        }

        public FieldMod add(FieldMod o) {
            long res = v + o.v;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new FieldMod(res);
        }

        public FieldMod sub(FieldMod o) {
            long res = v - o.v;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new FieldMod(res);
        }

        public FieldMod mul(FieldMod o) {
            return new FieldMod((v * o.v) % MOD);
        }

        public FieldMod div(FieldMod o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        public FieldMod inv() {
            return pow((int) (MOD - 2));
        }

        public FieldMod pow(int p) {
            long res = 1;
            long base = v;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                    res = (res * base) % MOD;
                }
                base = (base * base) % MOD;
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return new FieldMod(res);
        }

        public FieldMod neg() {
            if (v == 0) return new FieldMod(0);
            return new FieldMod(MOD - v);
        }

        public FieldMod inc() {
            v = (v + 1) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public FieldMod dec() {
            v = (v - 1 + MOD) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public boolean equals(FieldMod o) {
            return v == o.v;
        }

        public long getValue() {
            return v;
        }

        public static List<FieldMod> factorial(int t) {
            List<FieldMod> F = new ArrayList<>();
            F.add(new FieldMod(1));
            F.add(new FieldMod(1));
            for (int i = 2; i <= t; ++i) {
                F.add(F.get(i - 1).mul(new FieldMod(i)));
            }
            return F;
        }

        public static List<FieldMod> invFactorial(int t) {
            List<FieldMod> F = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= t; ++i) {
                F.add(new FieldMod(1));
            }
            FieldMod X = new FieldMod(1);
            for (int i = 2; i <= t; ++i) {
                X = X.mul(new FieldMod(i));
            }
            F.set(t, new FieldMod(1).div(X));
            for (int i = t - 1; i >= 2; --i) {
                F.set(i, F.get(i + 1).mul(new FieldMod(i + 1)));
            }
            return F;
        }
    }

    static class Ring {
        static long gcd(long a, long b) {
            if (a < b) {
                long temp = a;
                a = b;
                b = temp;
            }
            return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
        }

        static long div(long p, long q, long N) {
            long t = 0, nt = 1, r = N, nr = q;
            while (nr != 0) {
                long q_val = r / nr;
                long temp = t - q_val * nt;
                t = nt;
                nt = temp;
                temp = r - q_val * nr;
                r = nr;
                nr = temp;
            }
            t = (t < 0) ? t + N : t;
            r = (r < 0) ? r + N : r;
            if (gcd(p, N) % r != 0) {
                return 0;
            }
            return (t * p / r) % N;
        }
    }

    public void solve(Scanner cin, PrintWriter cout) {
        int N = cin.nextInt();
        int[][] P = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                P[i][j] = cin.nextInt();
            }
        }

        Map<BitSet, FieldMod> G = new HashMap<>();
        BitSet initial = new BitSet(128);
        initial.set(0);
        G.put(initial, new FieldMod(1));

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            Map<List<Integer>, FieldMod> H = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<BitSet, FieldMod> entry : G.entrySet()) {
                BitSet g = entry.getKey();
                List<Integer> S = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int m = 0; m < (1 << N); ++m) {
                    if (g.get(m)) {
                        S.add(m);
                    }
                }
                H.put(S, entry.getValue());
            }

            G.clear();

            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); ++j) {
                FieldMod pst = new FieldMod(1);
                for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                    if ((j & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                        pst = pst.mul(new FieldMod(P[i][k]));
                    } else {
                        pst = pst.mul(new FieldMod(100 - P[i][k]));
                    }
                }

                for (Map.Entry<List<Integer>, FieldMod> hEntry : H.entrySet()) {
                    List<Integer> hList = hEntry.getKey();
                    FieldMod hValue = hEntry.getValue();
                    BitSet ans = new BitSet(128);
                    for (int l = 0; l < N; ++l) {
                        if ((j & (1 << l)) == 0) continue;
                        for (int m : hList) {
                            if ((m & (1 << l)) == 0) {
                                ans.set(m | (1 << l));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (ans.cardinality() > 0) {
                        FieldMod newValue = hValue.mul(pst);
                        if (G.containsKey(ans)) {
                            G.put(ans, G.get(ans).add(newValue));
                        } else {
                            G.put(ans, newValue);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        FieldMod ans = new FieldMod(0);
        for (FieldMod val : G.values()) {
            ans = ans.add(val);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; ++i) {
            ans = ans.div(new FieldMod(100));
        }

        cout.println(ans.getValue());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner cin = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter cout = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        new Main().solve(cin, cout);
        cout.close();
    }
}
